:::{#rem-training-mse-optimistic}
#### Training error is optimistic

The same argument fails for the training set.
The training pairs are not independent of $\trainset$:
they are $\trainset$,
and $\fitted$ was fitted to make their prediction errors small.
So the step of @sol-held-out-unbiased labeled "each term, as above" does not hold for them,
and the [training error](#def-training-mse) $\trainerr$ is typically *smaller*
than $\generr_{\trainset}$ [@hastie2009elements, sec. 7.4].
@exr-overfitting shows the pattern:
training RMSE keeps falling as the degree grows,
while held-out RMSE does not.

:::
